Buy a Spanish Residence Permit on Telegram

A Spanish residence permit sold on Telegram is either a replica, a registered original, or a genuine document with your details typed in. Those three are priced differently and fail differently, and the advert rarely says which.

Issuing authority
the Oficina de Extranjeria
Observed price band
300–880 EUR
Typical delivery
3 to 21 days, tracked
Local name
tarjeta de identidad de extranjero
Document type
A residence permit is the card a country issues to a foreign national it has allowed to live there for a fixed term. It sits between a visa and permanent residence.

buy spanish residence permit on telegram – the short version

If you want the short version, a Spanish residence permit bought through Telegram is only worth the money when three things line up. The stock has to match what the Oficina de Extranjeria uses, the number has to follow that office format, and the seller has to survive a question about a feature a photocopier cannot copy.

Work through the rest of this page with the card in front of you if you can. The numbered process later on is the sequence to follow and the checks list is what to look for at each step.

Buy a Residence Permit via Telegram: how the transaction works

Ask for the issue date and the issuing office before you ask the price. A seller working with the Oficina de Extranjeria stock answers instantly. A reseller has to go and look, and that pause tells you where you sit in the chain.

If the seller wants to move to another app for payment, that is normal, but keep the conversation on Telegram. The chat is the only record that survives a disappearing account.

Who actually issues a Residence Permit

In Spain the office behind the residence permit is the Oficina de Extranjeria. The local name is tarjeta de identidad de extranjero. Use the local name in the chat and the seller immediately knows whether you have done any reading.

Register access varies. Some countries let you check a number online, some need the holder, some need a call. Ask the seller what route exists and expect a specific answer rather than a general one.

Replica or registered original

Replica and registered original are used interchangeably in adverts and they are not the same purchase. A replica is a print. It copies the layout and fails on UV, on substrate and on the number.

The failure modes are different too. A print fails the first UV torch. Stock fails the number. A registered original fails only if the entry has lapsed or the details do not match it.

What a fair price looks like

Observed adverts for a Spanish residence permit cluster between 300–880 EUR. That is the range to hold in your head, and it is deliberately wide because it covers three different products.

There is a floor below which the maths stops working for the seller. Below roughly the bottom third of the band, nobody is buying stock, so nobody is selling you stock.

The buying process, step by step

Follow these in sequence and stop at the first one that fails.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the Oficina de Extranjeria.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the Oficina de Extranjeria uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 300–880 EUR band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the checks that separate a real Spanish residence permit from a good print. All of them are cheap to run and two are local to Spain.

  • Confirm the DNI or passport number passes the Spanish check letter calculation for the letter printed.
  • Check the licence for the EU category grid and the DGT hologram.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the Oficina de Extranjeria. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

Any one of these is enough to walk away. Two together is a pattern.

  • A DNI where the control letter does not match the number.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What does a residence permit cost on Telegram?

Between 300 and 1400 US dollars. The permit number and the register entry carry most of the value.

How is it different from a visa?

A visa gets you in. A permit lets you stay. They are issued by different offices and checked differently.

Does it replace a green card?

Outside the United States it is the equivalent tier below permanent residence, not a replacement for it.

Why so expensive?

Because the number has to sit in an immigration register to be worth anything, and that is the hardest part to fake.

What is the common failure?

A permit class that sounds plausible but does not exist in the country scheme. Check the class list first.

Before you pay

The band for a Spanish residence permit in Spain is 300–880 EUR. Anything else needs a reason, so ask for it.
